pr_body:
Fixes #28396 (adding out-of-proc test)

When writing the new test we found that this feature regressed on Win11 because Http.Sys requires a new initialization flag for the feature detection API to work.

I also refactored the initialization logic so IsFeatureSupported is only called once at startup.

I plan to backport this to 6.0-rc2. We might also need to backport it to 5.0 if partners get blocked.
pr_comments:
Looks like this [doc](https://docs.microsoft.com/windows/win32/api/http/nf-http-httpinitialize#parameters) needs to be updated. The functions listed that require `HTTP_INITIALIZE_CONFIG` don't include `HttpIsFeatureSupported`

EDIT: Sent a PR- https://github.com/MicrosoftDocs/sdk-api/pull/906/files

issue_context.title: Add out-of-proc test for request queue delegation
issue_context.body: All the Http.Sys tests only verify delegating requests between two different Http.Sys queues in the same process. There are some behavioral differences (such as https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/pull/28336 ) that it would be good to validate

review_comments: What happen on older OSes that don't have this API?
HTTP_INITIALIZE_CONFIG isn't a new flag, I think it's been around forever. What changed is that HttpIsFeatureSupported now requires it.
Is there a reason why we don't want these to run on helix?
We never figured out how to make them work there. https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/8247
